headline: HuyenBao v11.45 — thiết kế lại toàn bộ giao diện: menu popup, dashboard no-scroll, biểu đồ + điều hướng
summary: FULL UI REDESIGN. (1) NAV → POPUP MENUS: the old horizontal gnav + subnav bars are replaced with compact dropdown popup menus. Each group (Character/Assets/Education/Career/Finance/Business/Network/Empire) is a button; clicking opens a popup with the group's sub-tabs as clickable links. Saves vertical space + groups related links. (2) DASHBOARD NO-SCROLL: PinZone is now the MAIN dashboard — everything the player needs at a glance (character, bars, sleep, asset chart, income) in ONE pinned card. Main page doesn't need to scroll for core info. (3) CLICKABLE NAVIGATION: every chart/bar in the dashboard is now a navigation link — click health bar → goes to Wellbeing tab; click asset chart → goes to Assets tab; click income → goes to Business tab; click XP bar → goes to Career tab. All navigation is intuitive. (4) CHARTS + CORRELATIONS: asset breakdown bar chart with 6 color-coded segments, income breakdown rows, health/spirit/XP progress bars — all visible at a glance + clickable.
features: NAV POPUP MENUS: 8 group buttons → dropdown popups with sub-tab links (replaces gnav+subnav bars)
DASHBOARD NO-SCROLL: PinZone is the main dashboard, all core info in one pinned card
CLICKABLE NAVIGATION: health bar→Wellbeing, asset chart→Assets, income→Business, XP→Career
CHARTS: asset breakdown bar (6 color segments), income rows, health/spirit/XP bars
COMPACT: nav buttons are small pills with icon+label, horizontal scroll on overflow
POPUP MENU: centered overlay with sub-tab links, click outside to close
